title: Neon Racer Trailer Beats
summary: Short game trailer prompt for a neon arcade racer with boost, drift, hazard dodge, score pop, and finish beat.
prompt: Create an 8-second game trailer motion plan for {argument name="game_title" default="Vector Rush"}, a neon arcade hover-racer. Beat 0-1s: black frame to pulsing title and synth-grid horizon. Beat 1-2.5s: camera drops behind the hovercraft, boost meter fills. Beat 2.5-4s: drift around a glowing corner, score multiplier pops. Beat 4-5.5s: hazard gate dodge with near-miss flash. Beat 5.5-7s: finish-line streak, leaderboard rank jumps. Beat 7-8s: end card with title and platform badges.
